purpose: Whole-company numbered end-to-end Minecraft strategy using Maizen and BigSchool as PUBLIC REFERENCES, not cloned production

lanes.focus: Two contrasting ORIGINAL actors with dialogue; mystery/challenge/build/save with genuine Minecraft footage
Original school/family/adventure with expressive acting, story beats, 3D world, cinematography, Foley

reference_videos.title: Mikey and JJ Choose the Right Hole in Minecraft
reference_videos.description_summary: Two pipes with right/wrong answers, treasure versus danger; describes guessing game
study_questions: Which decisions actually occur, in what order and at what timestamps?
How many genuine game-engine transitions, edit cuts and audio stings?
Does the story depend on real Minecraft mechanisms or staged mods?

reference_videos.title: Built a House inside BED in Minecraft
reference_videos.description_summary: Two characters secretly occupy a rival's house to recover stolen diamonds
creative_mechanic_hypotheses: Hidden base inside ordinary everyday object
study_questions: Which build actions are genuinely captured in-game?
How is danger of discovery communicated with sound and editing?
What repeated original set props or mod assets would be required?

reference_videos.title: Season 3 All Episode - Minecraft Animation
reference_videos.description_summary: Seven chapter titles with public chapters, from Baby Zombie homeless and family to rescue and knockdown challenge
creative_mechanic_hypotheses: Each self-contained original episode has setup/conflict/reaction/payoff
Compilation can package multiple validated stories, not a single-shot 69min render
Recurring rig/props/background sound methods worth studying
study_questions: What shots / 10-min story are actual versus chapter title implications?
Which character expressions and physical actions change outcomes?
Does each chapter use new assets or shared library?
What music license per chapter and resulting sound mix?
What percent original vs prior released compilations?

master_steps.instruction: Verify selected Maizen/BigSchool *official* sample identity, dates, long-form duration and weak-control selection
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No direct-video duration/age proof means research-only, never breakout certified

master_steps.instruction: Lawfully obtain actual full playable video+audio for each selected sample; timecode scenes, chapters and visual proof
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: FULL_VIDEO_WATCH requires verified decoded whole footage and soundtrack

master_steps.instruction: Analyze hooks, A/B choices, hidden base and BigSchool seven-chapter original/compilation structure
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Metadata guesses explicitly separate from observed frames/audio

master_steps.instruction: Score niches with longform >8min demand, fresh-channel signals, repeatability, monetization and legal risk
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No unsupported claim new 30-day channel won 2x1M in 14d

master_steps.instruction: Approve one first original series promise and pilot scope/budget before longform
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Owner approval for planned spend or production switch

master_steps.instruction: Create 10 original concepts, score and select ONE coherent story (not retell Maizen/BigSchool)
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Fresh character/location/conflict and English-audience hook

master_steps.instruction: Expand chosen concept into scene/beat graph, consistent motivations and prop/time continuity
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Every beat alters plot stakes and has logical next action

master_steps.instruction: Director storyboards shot-by-shot; thumbnail/animatic with edit timing and audio spots
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: At least 30-60s original pilot narrative is understandable and art approved

master_steps.instruction: Original world designs and lighting/color palette: school/village/cave OR real Minecraft playable world
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: World original or properly licensed and accessible by target renderer

master_steps.instruction: Create two original rigged 64x64 skins + second layers, eye/viseme controls, hand sockets and versioned props
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No temporary debug cuboids or copied JJ/Mikey skin as production asset

master_steps.instruction: Prepare body and facial action libraries, original voice/timing, actor emotions and lip sync
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Rig weight/IK FK, turn, walk footplant, grasp, fall, expression QA

master_steps.instruction: Build locked shot cameras, geography and color/lighting cues
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No random zooms or incoherent eyelines; action readable mobile

master_steps.instruction: Compare existing Blender 4.5/Comfy/audio/edit before adding optional Blockbench, Mineways, real-game capture, MCP
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Same-shot GPU/time/visual+audio evidence; no arbitrary Python/cloud credits

master_steps.instruction: Clear skin/rig/scene/music/voice and Minecraft publisher guideline scope and YouTube repetition risk
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No publication or brand use until scope approved

master_steps.instruction: Lock shot schedule: durations, takes, render presets, failure budgets and storage capacity
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: RTX 3060 memory and acceptance throughput feasible

master_steps.instruction: Select per-shot source of truth: REAL_MINECRAFT_CAPTURE or AUTHORED_3D_ANIMATION
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No Blender fake-gameplay output labelled real play

master_steps.instruction: Create/block real shots or capture authentic game actions with replay/camera control; keep layered takes
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Actual decodable video, not placeholder paths, hashes and context

master_steps.instruction: Only optional authorized local AI for clean concept/VFX plates; cloud model requires explicit budget
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No silently changed identity, unlicensed training/asset or credits

master_steps.instruction: Add physically motivated particles/light/prop contact and continuity-safe compositing
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Every effect supports story and matches shots

master_steps.instruction: Create synced dialogue, Foley, ambience, music and loudness/no-clip review
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: VO understandable, sync within reviewed tolerance, licenses documented

master_steps.instruction: Cut scenes/chapters, track continuity and tension, avoid padding to 8 minutes
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Accepted narrative pacing before longform length

master_steps.instruction: Shot-match and color/lighting changes with consistent identity under SDR
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Lighting and original palette pass in motion

master_steps.instruction: Independent inspect full decoded film+sound, character identity, framing, timing, copyright, tech metadata
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Fail closed missing real >30s 1080p24 quality pilot + owner acceptance

master_steps.instruction: Render/retry only defective shots, reproducible hashes, storage backups and recovery
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: No silent skipping of failed shots; source and version preserved

master_steps.instruction: Create 2 original thumbnail/title variants, description, episode chapter names and subtitle/caption checks
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Honest Minecraft animation vs authentic game recording labeling

master_steps.instruction: Owner release decision with QC signed, eligible rights and human final watch
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Zero auto-upload without independently approved release

master_steps.instruction: After publishing, measure YouTube 24h/7d/14d, own CTR/retention/watch time/RPM where connected
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Only own actual provider analytics; never infer from public video views

master_steps.instruction: Root-cause underperforming shots, update versioned skills/tests and next original episode recipe
master_steps.blocking_acceptance: Improvement requires A/B/evidence and no silent production regression
